Black Jumper is an engaging and fast-paced arcade browser game developed by GamePix. This game takes the classic genre of endless runners and turns it on its head by introducing a unique twist - the player controls a black ball that can jump between platforms, while avoiding falling down. The game is all about timing and precision, as the player must carefully plan their jumps to get the maximum score.
